Man in iconic 9/11 Twin Towers photo speaks out

A man pictured fleeing the World Trade Center's Twin Towers on September 11, 2001, carrying a briefcase, has spoken about the event. He stated that missing the elevator was what saved his life. The image of him running from the towers has become iconic.
